# weft_tenant (Resource)

Tenant (top-level isolation unit). Mirrors CreateTenant / DeleteTenant. The proto has no mutators for name / domain — both are RequiresReplace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Tenant DNS domain (e.g. "acme.example.com"). Immutable.
- `name` (String) Tenant display name. Immutable (no RenameTenant in the proto).

### Read-Only

- `admins` (Number) Count of admins.
- `created_at` (String) Unix nanosecond timestamp of creation.
- `id` (String) Mirrors `uuid`; satisfies the Terraform ID convention.
- `members` (Number) Count of members (admins included).
- `projects` (Number) Count of projects in this tenant.
- `status` (String) "active" | "disabled".
- `uuid` (String) Server-minted tenant UUID.
